bicameral_note: Population representation and equal constituent representation vote as separate kinds; both must agree where required.
chamber_page.about: The chamber is circular — there is no head of the room; the Speaker presides from among equals and votes only to break ties (Art. II §3). Seat-map seniority and the roster's normalized vote share are display of certified records.
chamber_page.browse_lead: Browse every legislature on the instance from the
chamber_page.countback_gloss: Countback first (the voters' prior ballots decide), special election only when ballots exhaust · Art. II §5.
chamber_page.empty_note: Jurisdictions activate at critical population · CLK-06.
chamber_page.forming_body: This legislature has no seated members yet. The seat map appears when the first general election certifies; the first-sessions checklist below is the constituting to-do list.
chamber_page.next_election: The next election exists from the moment the prior one certifies.
chamber_page.next_session_due: next session due by {date} · CLK-02 · the scheduler compels it (WF-SYS-02)
chamber_page.no_active_chain: No active legislature in your association chain.
chamber_page.no_vacancies: No open vacancies — every seat is either serving or filled.
chamber_page.norm_share_note: normalized vote share = the certification's quota-normalized support · committee tie-break currency · ledger #q2
chamber_page.open_session_console: Open the session console — speaker balloting →
chamber_page.seat_map_note: seniority-alternating seating · vacancies join at the junior-most position · seniority = days served, ties by normalized vote share (ledger #q2)
chamber_page.term_lockstep: term lockstep · CLK-01 / CLK-10 — elections cannot be skipped or delayed
chamber_page.term_title: Term — one clock for every elected office
chamber_page.title: Chamber — {name}
gallery: Public gallery · You are viewing this session’s public record.
index.about: WF-JUR-01 — jurisdictions bootstrap from dormant boundary to self-governing. Each activation seats a cube-root-sized legislature (bicameral where constituent jurisdictions exist, Art. V §3) plus executive and judiciary stubs.
index.caption: Legislatures, by jurisdiction
index.empty: No legislatures yet — complete setup (apportionment) to found the first one.
index.intro: Every legislature on this instance. Setup founds the first — the root jurisdiction’s; additional legislatures activate as jurisdictions reach critical population (CLK-06). Open a row to view its districts in the mapper; the Election column jumps straight to each chamber’s current election and results.
index.showing_largest: Showing the {shown} largest chambers of {total} — reach any other legislature by drilling to its jurisdiction in the map viewer.
map_intro: Explore the districts and compare the recorded map plans for this legislature.
members_intro: See who serves, inspect the chamber seating and follow the work of constituting this legislature.

session_archive.title: Session archive
session_console.about: The session machine: scheduled → open → adjourned, with the failed-quorum branch (WF-LEG-20). Quorum counts precede everything; it is the call itself, not an agenda item.
session_console.adjourn_gloss: Adjournment is the Speaker's (or admin staff's) filing — F-SPK-009.
session_console.agenda_note: slots 1–2 locked: outstanding emergency powers first, constitutional matters second — cannot be reordered or removed · Art. II §2; §7 · hardened
session_console.attendance_note: attendance feeds the quorum call and the public record — never a vote denominator
session_console.balloting_open: balloting open — {cast} of {serving} serving have cast · closes at full participation
session_console.call_hint: Opens immediately: serving + quorum snapshot through the protected functions; attendance rows materialize absent until members register.
session_console.called_by_speaker: Sessions are called by the chamber's Speaker (or the system under CLK-02).
session_console.due_banner: Session due in {days} {unit} (by {due}) — discretion can never produce "no session"; the scheduler compels it.
session_console.last_balloting: last balloting closed {outcome} — a failed balloting never auto-loops; open a new ballot (WF-LEG-02)
session_console.minutes_hint: Sealed to the public record; adjourning a quorum-met session re-arms CLK-02 from the meeting — the confirmation shows the re-armed deadline.
session_console.motion_text_hint: The deciding vote opens in the same filing — ordinary majority of all serving.
session_console.no_session_ever: No session has ever been held — the first session constitutes the legislature (WF-LEG-01); see the
session_console.opened_line: opened {opened} · serving at open {serving} · stored as UTC
session_console.peg_quorum_kind_note: peg quorum of this kind: {req} of {serving} serving · Art. V §3 · ledger #q7
session_console.peg_quorum_note: peg quorum {req} of {serving} — majorities compute against all serving members, never those present · Art. II §2
session_console.public_rankings: public rankings — chamber votes are the opposite of ballots · Art. II §2
session_console.quorum_failed_body: Compel attendance, then re-publish the count when members arrive; or adjourn & reschedule inside the CLK-02 window. Repeated failure refers to the administrative office.
session_console.quorum_failed_note: Art. II §2 · the 90-day clock is still enforced — a failed-quorum session never resets it
session_console.record_summary: Opened {opened} · adjourned {adjourned} · quorum {quorum} ({present} of {serving} serving present; required {required}).
session_console.speaker_presides: The Speaker presides and does not move or vote on business — only the tie-breaking vote (F-SPK-004) · Art. II §3.
session_console.statement_hint: Entered verbatim into the immutable public record · WF-SYS-03.
session_console.title: Session console — {name}
session_console.winner: winner: {name} — seated as Speaker · public record kind certification
session_intro: Follow attendance, the agenda, motions and votes. Session minutes remain available after adjournment.
settings_page.about: A setting change is a bill whose enactment writes the constitutional_settings record (WF-LEG-14 wraps the ordinary WF-LEG-06 bill flow). Hardened-layer changes have only one door: constitutional amendment (WF-SYS-05).
settings_page.floor_supermajority: supermajority can never fall below majority + 1 · Art. VII
settings_page.floor_title: The hardened floor — what no act can change
settings_page.floor_voting_method: voting_method — only a MORE proportional method, never FPTP or plurality · Art. II §2
settings_page.in_range_body: A direct filing lands an F-LEG-031 amendment bill; the value applies only when the chamber enacts it at a peg-quorum floor vote. · WF-LEG-14 · Art. VII.
settings_page.in_range_title: In range — the amendment may proceed to a vote.
settings_page.intro: These are the rules this legislature can change by passing a law (its "constitutional settings") — each one inside limits that no law can override. Out-of-range proposals are rejected before any vote is taken.
settings_page.lockstep_note: must stay in lockstep · CLK-09 / CLK-10
settings_page.no_changes: No setting changes on this page.
settings_page.propose_hint: Pick "Propose change" on any row above to pre-target a bill at that setting.
settings_page.prov_default: Template default · in force since founding
settings_page.rejected_prevote_body: The Constitutional Engine blocks the bill before any vote is taken — no UI, admin panel, or legislative act can carry an out-of-range value; an actual filing of this value would land as a rejected=true audit-chain entry.
settings_page.rejected_title: Rejected — the engine blocked this amendment before any vote.

speaker: Speaker work
speaker_destination: Session controls, committee work and oversight are available from the legislature navigation above.
speaker_election_waiting: Members elect the Speaker before ordinary session business begins.
speaker_intro: Record member priorities, review tie-breaking votes and follow pending removal proceedings.
speaker_read_only: You can review this office’s records. Its controls are available to the current Speaker.
speaker_tools.about: This page never duplicates a console: F-SPK-001/002/003/008/009 run on the session console, F-SPK-005 on the committees page, F-SPK-007 on oversight. The tie-break record and priorities queue live here because they are records of the office itself.
speaker_tools.explore_body: Follow this office through the public chamber, live room and session records. Official actions use the current officeholder’s account.
speaker_tools.facilitation_none: Facilitation targets an upcoming session — none is scheduled; call one on the
speaker_tools.find_speaker: Find the current Speaker in the
speaker_tools.link_chamber: Enter the live chamber — recognize speakers and follow the speaking queue
speaker_tools.link_committees: Follow committee work — hearings, evidence and reports
speaker_tools.link_oversight: Open oversight — removal proceedings and presiding responsibilities
speaker_tools.link_records: Browse session records — past agendas, votes and public statements
speaker_tools.link_session: Open the session workspace — attendance, quorum, agenda and minutes
speaker_tools.neutral_chip: politically neutral · votes only to break ties · Art. II §3
speaker_tools.neutral_gloss: The Speaker stays in every quorum and threshold denominator. On yes/no business a Speaker cast is rejected pre-commit unless the vote stands tied — and a tie-break never manufactures a supermajority (Art. VII).
speaker_tools.no_tie: No tie has needed breaking this term.
speaker_tools.presiding_gloss: The Speaker presides over every removal proceeding except their own case, where the chamber designates a substitute.
speaker_tools.priorities_gloss: Members hand the Speaker their priorities; facilitation appends each to the next session's unlocked agenda tail. The filing itself is the priorities log — slots 1–2 (emergency powers, constitutional matters) stay locked (Art. II §2).
speaker_tools.subject_blocked: You are the subject — the engine blocks you from presiding; the chamber designates a substitute · Art. II §3 (removal.presider, hardened).
speaker_tools.tiebreak_gloss: The only Speaker votes on record — each cast via F-SPK-004 on a vote that closed tied, recomputed against the unchanged peg threshold.
speaker_tools.title: Speaker tools — {name}
statement_empty: Members can publish statements during the session. Published statements are part of the public record.
threshold_note: These thresholds use the current serving membership and this legislature’s settings. Individual votes retain their recorded thresholds.
